## Executive Summary

**How bad is it?** Fundamentally healthy — clean static HTML, valid metadata on every page, a complete schema ecosystem, and correct `robots.txt`/`sitemap.xml`/`llms.txt`. The remaining risks are structural rather than content-level: the entire navigation, footer, category grids, and one JSON-LD block are injected at runtime by `layout.js`, one page (`pages/sitemap.html`) ships 10 broken internal links, and the homepage canonical conflicts with the root-URL convention used by every internal link and JSON-LD reference.

- **Pages audited:** 32
- **Total findings:** 10 (3 High, 3 Medium, 4 Low)
- **Crawlability:** OK — all pages static, indexable, `lang`/charset/viewport present, robots + sitemap correct. JS-injection is the single point of failure (Finding 1).
- **Rich results:** SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, WebSite SearchAction all valid. Article schema has a `publisher.logo` warning (Finding 8); video embeds are not marked up (Finding 9).
- **Most important action:** Make navigation and the Organization schema static (or add a `<noscript>` fallback) so the link graph survives JavaScript failure — then fix the 10 broken links in `pages/sitemap.html`.

## Granular Pillar Evaluations

### 1. Technical SEO / JavaScript SEO

- **Files Audited:** `assets/js/layout.js`, `assets/js/catalog.js`, `assets/js/home-catalog.js`, all HTML pages
- **Passed Checks:** All pages static with `lang`, charset, viewport; no `noindex` leaks on indexable pages; no staging/dev domains found; canonical on every page; robots.txt correct; no parameterized URLs, no crawl traps.

**Issue 1.1 — Site-wide navigation, footer, category/tool grids, and one JSON-LD block are injected at runtime with no fallback.**
- **Severity:** High
- **Location:** `assets/js/layout.js:53-343` (header/footer/CTA/search/back-to-top), `assets/js/layout.js:318-343` (Organization JSON-LD), `assets/js/catalog.js:76-125` (tool grid), `assets/js/home-catalog.js:14-28` (homepage category grid), skeleton placeholders in `index.html:129-135`, `tools/index.html:46-53`, `tools/*/index.html:46-53`.
- **Problem:** Every page loads as a bare `<body>` with empty skeleton divs; `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<footer>` and the Organization schema only appear after `layout.js` executes. Google does render JavaScript, but this (a) makes the entire link graph dependent on a single script resolving correctly from each subfolder, (b) delays discovery of every page that is linked only from the injected nav/footer, and (c) means a single JS error (e.g. a wrong relative path to `tools-data.js`) silently strips navigation from every page.
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <!-- index.html:73 -->
  <!-- Header (navbar + mobile menu) and footer are auto-injected by assets/js/layout.js -->
  <!-- ...no <nav>/<footer> markup exists in any file until JS runs -->
  ```
- **Root Cause:** GitHub Pages has no server-side includes, so DRY was achieved via JS injection — a defensible trade-off, but it trades crawl resilience for DRY. Google Search Central's guidance on JS rendering explicitly warns that relying on JS for core navigation/content adds a rendering dependency for indexation.
- **Ranking Impact:** Category and tool pages are linked from the JS-rendered grid/nav; if rendering fails or is slow, Google's discovery of those pages degrades and deep pages lose their path from the homepage.
- **Fix:** (1) Move the Organization JSON-LD into a static `<head>` block on every page (remove the JS injection at `layout.js:318-343`); (2) add a `<noscript>` fallback nav on every page:
  ```html
  <!-- Place immediately after <body> on every page -->
  <noscript>
    <nav aria-label="Primary">
      <a href="index.html">Home</a> |
      <a href="tools/index.html">Tools</a> |
      <a href="pages/about.html">About</a> |
      <a href="pages/contact.html">Contact</a>
    </nav>
  </noscript>
  ```
  *(Adjust relative paths per directory depth: `../` inside `tools/`, `../../` inside `tools/*/`.)*
- **Implementation Guidance:** Do the JSON-LD move first (30 min, pure find-replace across files), then add the `<noscript>` block to the 5 page depths (root, `pages/`, `press/`, `tools/`, `tools/*/`).
- **Fix Type:** structural
- **Verification:** Disable JavaScript in a headless crawl (or `curl` the raw HTML) and confirm nav links and Organization schema are present in the un-rendered source.

### 2. Internal Linking

- **Files Audited:** `pages/sitemap.html`, all cross-page `href`s
- **Passed Checks:** All other pages' internal links resolve; footer/nav targets correct; no `nofollow` on internal links.

**Issue 2.1 — `pages/sitemap.html` ships 10 broken internal links (2 wrong paths to real tools + 8 to non-existent pages).**
- **Severity:** High
- **Location:** `pages/sitemap.html:48-69`
- **Problem:** The HTML sitemap is the user-facing map of the site and is linked from the footer on every page. Ten of its links 404: `disclaimer.html` and `editorial-policies.html` resolve under `pages/` but actually live in `press/`; `privacy.html`/`terms.html` do not exist in this repo; `../tools/word-counter.html` and `../tools/json-formatter.html` point to the wrong subfolder; and six entries (`social-media-word-counter`, `reading-time`, `html-entity-encoder`, `password-generator`, `uuid-generator`, `character-frequency`) point to tools that do not exist.
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <li><a href="disclaimer.html">Disclaimer</a></li>
  <li><a href="privacy.html">Privacy Policy</a></li>
  <li><a href="terms.html">Terms of Service</a></li>
  <li><a href="editorial-policies.html">Editorial Policies</a></li>
  <li><a href="../tools/word-counter.html">Word Counter</a></li>
  <li><a href="../tools/json-formatter.html">JSON Formatter &amp; Validator</a></li>
  <li><a href="../tools/social-media-word-counter.html">Social Media Word Counter</a></li>
  ...
  ```
- **Root Cause:** The sitemap page was authored before the `press/` folder and the `text/`/`coding/` subfolders existed and was never reconciled.
- **Ranking Impact:** Broken links waste crawl budget, erode trust in the crawl graph, and cost `word-counter` and `json-formatter` two internal anchor paths. 404s from an HTML page explicitly designed for navigation is a visible UX defect.
- **Fix:**
  ```html
  <h2 class="heading-2" style="margin-top: 2rem;">Information</h2>
  <ul>
      <li><a href="../press/disclaimer.html">Disclaimer</a></li>
      <li><a href="https://f9xr.github.io/legals/privacy.html">Privacy Policy</a></li>
      <li><a href="https://f9xr.github.io/legals/terms.html">Terms of Service</a></li>
      <li><a href="../press/editorial-policies.html">Editorial Policies</a></li>
      <li><a href="accessibility-statement.html">Accessibility Statement</a></li>
  </ul>

  <h2 class="heading-2" style="margin-top: 2rem;">Tools</h2>
  <ul>
      <li><a href="../tools/text/word-counter.html">Word Counter</a></li>
      <li><a href="../tools/text/numeronym-generator.html">Numeronym Generator</a></li>
      <li><a href="../tools/coding/json-formatter.html">JSON Formatter &amp; Validator</a></li>
      <li><a href="../tools/youtube/timestamp-link-generator.html">YouTube Timestamp Link Generator</a></li>
      <li><a href="../tools/audio/song-length-calculator.html">Song Length Calculator</a></li>
  </ul>
  ```
- **Implementation Guidance:** Replace lines 47-69. Remove the six non-existent tool entries entirely (do not link to pages you plan to build later — add them when they exist).
- **Fix Type:** linking
- **Verification:** `curl -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/pages/sitemap.html` then click every link; or run a link checker.

### 3. URL Structure & Canonicalization

- **Files Audited:** `index.html`, `sitemap.xml`, `layout.js`, tool pages, `llms.txt`
- **Passed Checks:** Slug structure clean (`/tools/<category>/<tool>.html`); trailing-slash consistent (`.html` everywhere); no query parameters; no underscores; sitemap URLs match file paths.

**Issue 3.1 — Homepage canonical points to `/troolify/index.html` but every internal link, breadcrumb, JSON-LD `url`, and `llms.txt` reference the root `/troolify/`.**
- **Severity:** High
- **Location:** `index.html:10` (canonical) vs `index.html:49,66` (WebSite JSON-LD), `assets/js/layout.js:79,105` (nav "Home"), `tools/text/word-counter.html:34` (breadcrumb Home, repeated on 4 other tool pages), `llms.txt:17`, `sitemap.xml:4` (sitemap agrees with the canonical — the links disagree).
- **Problem:** GitHub Pages serves both `https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/` and `https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html` as 200s. The canonical + sitemap say `index.html`; the nav, breadcrumbs, and schema say root. Google will eventually dedupe, but the conflicting signals on the site's highest-value URL delay consolidation and dilute the homepage's internal-link equity between two URLs.
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <!-- index.html:10 -->
  <link rel="canonical" href="https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html">
  ```
  ```json
  // index.html:49 (JSON-LD url) and layout.js:79 (nav Home href)
  "url": "https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/"
  <a href="https://f9xr.github.io/troolify">Home</a>
  ```
- **Root Cause:** Mixed conventions — `.html` canonicals everywhere, but bare-root URL for the homepage in prose/link markup.
- **Ranking Impact:** Possible split of homepage signals between two URLs; minor crawl inefficiency. Cheap to fix, high value because it's the homepage.
- **Fix:** Standardize on `https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html` (matches the sitemap + the `.html` convention on all 31 other pages). Update:
  - `index.html:49` and `index.html:66` → `"url": "https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html"` (and the SearchAction target stays `/tools/index.html?q=...`).
  - `assets/js/layout.js:79` and `:105` → `href="https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html"`.
  - Breadcrumb Home `item` on all 5 tool pages → `https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html`.
  - `llms.txt:17` → `https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html`.
- **Implementation Guidance:** Global find-replace of `f9xr.github.io/troolify"` → `f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html"` in the listed files (be careful to only match the root URL, not `/tools/...`).
- **Fix Type:** config / linking
- **Verification:** Google Search Console URL Inspection on `https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/` should show canonical to `.../index.html` after re-crawl.

### 4. Social & Regional SEO

- **Files Audited:** all HTML pages
- **Passed Checks:** OG + Twitter present on all 5 tool pages and homepage; `og:type`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `twitter:card` valid; no social profile mismatches.

**Issue 4.1 — Incomplete social meta on non-tool pages: `og:description` missing on 2 pages, `twitter:description` missing on 9 pages, no `og:image:width/height` anywhere; `og-image.png` is a 169 KB 1408×768 PNG.**
- **Severity:** Medium
- **Location:** `pages/sitemap.html`, `pages/accessibility-statement.html` (no `og:description`); `pages/about.html`, `pages/contact.html`, `pages/feedback.html`, `pages/sitemap.html`, `pages/accessibility-statement.html`, `press/editorial-policies.html`, `press/disclaimer.html`, `tools/index.html`, all 19 `tools/*/index.html` (no `twitter:description`); every page (no `og:image:width`/`og:image:height`).
- **Problem:** Sharing any of these pages on X/LinkedIn/Slack renders a card with a title but no description, and the crawler must infer the image size (minor). The OG image is a legacy PNG at 169 KB and 1408×768 (recommended: 1200×630).
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <!-- pages/sitemap.html:11-17 — no og:description -->
  <meta property="og:title" content="Sitemap - Troolify">
  <meta property="og:type" content="website">
  ...
  ```
- **Root Cause:** Tool pages got the full social-meta template in the last audit; the info/category pages only got a partial one.
- **Ranking Impact:** Social share CTR and on-platform snippet completeness on 9 pages; no direct ranking effect.
- **Fix:** Add to the two pages missing `og:description`:
  ```html
  <meta property="og:description" content="Browse every page, category, and tool on Troolify in one place.">
  ```
  (accessibility-statement.html: `"Troolify's commitment to making our free online tools usable by everyone."`) and add to all 9 pages lacking it:
  ```html
  <meta name="twitter:description" content="<mirror the meta description>">
  ```
  On every page, declare image dimensions (matches the actual file):
  ```html
  <meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
  <meta property="og:image:height" content="630">
  ```
  Preferred: re-export `assets/images/og-image.png` as a 1200×630 WebP (`og-image.webp`, ~40 KB) and update all `og:image`/`twitter:image` URLs + the declared dimensions.
- **Implementation Guidance:** Template-level edit across the 9 pages; then regenerate the OG asset.
- **Fix Type:** metadata
- **Verification:** Run any page through the [Facebook Sharing Debugger](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/) and the [LinkedIn Post Inspector](https://www.linkedin.com/post-inspector/) and confirm a description renders.

### 5. Image SEO / Performance

- **Files Audited:** 5 tool pages' `.seo-article` figures, `assets/images/*`
- **Passed Checks:** Self-hosted hero images are WebP with preload; explicit `width`/`height` everywhere; descriptive alt text; below-the-fold images lazy-loaded; no legacy GIF/BMP.

**Issue 5.1 — 12 in-article images are hotlinked from `source.unsplash.com` (deprecated, unreliable endpoint) as 1600×900 JPEGs.**
- **Severity:** Medium
- **Location:** `tools/text/word-counter.html:288,333,377`, `tools/text/numeronym-generator.html` (×3), `tools/audio/song-length-calculator.html` (×3), `tools/youtube/timestamp-link-generator.html` (×3)
- **Problem:** `source.unsplash.com` is a deprecated dynamic-resize endpoint that redirects and has been known to rate-limit or break for hotlinkers. When it breaks, your article images 404 — an ugly UX hole and an empty-image failure for the page. The images are also 1600×900 (display ~1200px), i.e. oversized and non-WebP.
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <img src="https://source.unsplash.com/1600x900/?writing,laptop,notebook"
       alt="Person writing on a laptop with a notebook beside it" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="900">
  ```
- **Root Cause:** External image convenience over self-hosting.
- **Ranking Impact:** Image-search exposure and page reliability; no Core Web Vitals impact today (below the fold, dimensions declared).
- **Fix:** Download each image once into `assets/images/article/` (WebP, ~1200px wide) and reference locally:
  ```html
  <img src="../../assets/images/article/word-counter-writing.webp"
       alt="Person writing on a laptop with a notebook beside it" loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675">
  ```
- **Implementation Guidance:** Use an image tool/script to fetch + convert the 12 URLs, then find-replace the `<img>` tags (keep alt text).
- **Fix Type:** performance / image
- **Verification:** `curl -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" <local image URL>` returns 200; confirm no `source.unsplash.com` references remain via `Select-String`.

**Issue 6.1 — Indexable page missing from sitemap; homepage stats and `llms.txt` are stale.**
- **Severity:** Medium
- **Location:** `tools/audio/index.html` (indexable, has a live tool, not in `sitemap.xml`); `index.html:338,340` (`3` Live Tools / `18` Categories — reality: **5** tools, **19** categories); `llms.txt:8-14` (lists 4 tools, omits Numeronym Generator; no license/citation section).
- **Problem:** `tools/audio/index.html` is the only indexable category with a live tool that is absent from the sitemap. The homepage stat "3 Live Tools" contradicts the 5 real tool pages and the catalog, and `llms.txt` under-reports the tool inventory LLMs/AI crawlers can discover.
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <!-- index.html:338 -->
  <div class="stat-number">3</div><div class="stat-label">Live Tools</div>
  <div class="stat-number">18</div><div class="stat-label">Categories</div>
  ```
- **Root Cause:** Content shipped faster than the numbers and sitemap were updated.
- **Ranking Impact:** One indexable category depends on JS-grid discovery alone; stale stats mildly erode trust; `llms.txt` is an AI-crawl surface that is now incomplete.
- **Fix:** Add to `sitemap.xml` (after the `tools/youtube/index.html` entry):
  ```xml
  <url>
    <loc>https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/audio/index.html</loc>
    <lastmod>2026-08-15</lastmod>
    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>
    <priority>0.6</priority>
  </url>
  ```
  Update `index.html:338` → `<div class="stat-number">5</div>` and `:340` → `<div class="stat-number">19</div>`. Add to `llms.txt` under `## Tools`:
  ```markdown
  - [Numeronym Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/numeronym-generator.html): Turn any word into a numeronym like i18n or k8s, or decode one back.
  ```
  and a closing section:
  ```markdown
  ## License & Citation
  - Content: CC-BY-4.0. Source: https://github.com/f9xr/troolify (Open Source).
  - Cite as: "Troolify by F9XR Team — https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/"
  ```
- **Implementation Guidance:** Three small edits; also update the `## Tools` count references anywhere else they appear (e.g. `pages/about.html` prose).
- **Fix Type:** config / content
- **Verification:** Validate `sitemap.xml` with an XML checker; re-read the rendered homepage stats.

### 7. URL Architecture

- **Files Audited:** `tools.html`, `assets/js/layout.js`
- **Passed Checks:** No `?page=` patterns, no `http://` internal links, consistent protocol/domain.

**Issue 7.1 — Primary nav "Tools"/"Utilities" routes through a `meta refresh` redirect (`tools.html`).**
- **Severity:** Low
- **Location:** `assets/js/layout.js:80` (header "Tools"), `:106` (mobile menu "Tools"), `:148` (footer "Utilities") → `tools.html` → `tools/index.html`
- **Problem:** `tools.html` is a `noindex` page that only does `<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=tools/index.html">`. Every click on the main "Tools" nav item spends a redirect hop, and a 0-second meta refresh is a weaker signal than a direct link (and briefly renders a blank page for users without JS redirect handling).
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <!-- tools.html:7-11 -->
  <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=tools/index.html">
  <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">
  ```
  ```js
  // layout.js:80
  '<a href="' + prefix + 'tools.html">Tools</a>' +
  ```
- **Root Cause:** `tools.html` predates `tools/index.html` and was kept as a compatibility URL.
- **Ranking Impact:** Marginal — one extra hop on the main nav; the redirect is already noindex'd so no duplicate-content risk.
- **Fix:** Point the three nav links directly at the catalog (keep `tools.html` file as a legacy redirect for anyone with the old URL):
  ```js
  // layout.js:80 and :106
  '<a href="' + prefix + 'tools/index.html">Tools</a>' +
  // layout.js:148
  '<li><a href="' + prefix + 'tools/index.html" class="text-white/80 transition hover:text-[#3B82F6]">Utilities</a></li>' +
  ```
- **Implementation Guidance:** 3-line change in `layout.js`; no server-side change needed.
- **Fix Type:** linking
- **Verification:** Load a page with devtools, click "Tools", confirm the address goes straight to `/tools/index.html`.

### 8. Structured Data

- **Files Audited:** all JSON-LD blocks on the 5 tool pages + homepage + contact
- **Passed Checks:** WebSite+SearchAction, Organization, ContactPage, SoftwareApplication (`applicationCategory` values valid: `UtilitiesApplication`, `DeveloperApplication`), FAQPage, BreadcrumbList all structurally valid; JSON parses cleanly; FAQ answers mirror visible content.

**Issue 8.1 — Article schema on all 5 tool pages is missing `publisher.logo`.**
- **Severity:** Low
- **Location:** `tools/text/word-counter.html:83-87`, `tools/text/numeronym-generator.html`, `tools/coding/json-formatter.html`, `tools/audio/song-length-calculator.html`, `tools/youtube/timestamp-link-generator.html` (Article JSON-LD `publisher`)
- **Problem:** Google's Rich Results Test flags `publisher` without `logo` (a warning; required only for AMP). It's a one-line fix that makes the Article markup fully clean and consistent with the Organization/WebSite schema already using the same logo.
- **Current Code:**
  ```json
  "publisher": {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "Troolify",
    "url": "https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/"
  }
  ```
- **Root Cause:** Publisher logo omitted when the Article schema was templated.
- **Ranking Impact:** Article rich-result eligibility warning only; no blocking.
- **Fix:**
  ```json
  "publisher": {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "Troolify",
    "url": "https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/index.html",
    "logo": {
      "@type": "ImageObject",
      "url": "https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/assets/images/logo_nobg.webp"
    }
  }
  ```
- **Implementation Guidance:** Same block in all 5 tool files (find-replace the `publisher` object).
- **Fix Type:** schema
- **Verification:** Paste one page into the [Rich Results Test](https://search.google.com/test/rich-results) and confirm zero warnings on Article.

### 9. Video SEO

- **Files Audited:** 5 tool pages (YouTube embeds)
- **Passed Checks:** Embeds are lazy-loaded and CLS-safe (`.video-wrap` reserves `aspect-ratio: 16/9`, iframe fills it — no layout shift).

**Issue 9.1 — Embedded walkthrough videos have no `VideoObject` schema, no on-page transcript, and use non-privacy-enhanced embeds.**
- **Severity:** Low
- **Location:** `tools/text/word-counter.html:339` (embed `mx69cUvnd_I`), `tools/text/numeronym-generator.html` (`0j74jcxSunY`), `tools/coding/json-formatter.html` (`JuFdz8f-cT4`), `tools/audio/song-length-calculator.html` (`GZLXRc3aFxc`), `tools/youtube/timestamp-link-generator.html` (`b1Fo_M_tj6w`)
- **Problem:** (a) No `VideoObject` JSON-LD means the videos cannot surface as video rich results or in Google Video; (b) no text transcript means the video's audio content contributes no indexable text; (c) embeds use `www.youtube.com` instead of `www.youtube-nocookie.com` (privacy mode).
- **Current Code:**
  ```html
  <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/mx69cUvnd_I" title="Why word count matters for content and SEO" ... loading="lazy"></iframe>
  ```
- **Root Cause:** Video markup was not part of the tool-page template.
- **Ranking Impact:** Missed video-rich-result eligibility; audio track not indexable.
- **Fix:** Switch to privacy-enhanced embeds and add `VideoObject` JSON-LD per video:
  ```html
  <iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/mx69cUvnd_I" title="Why word count matters for content and SEO" ... loading="lazy"></iframe>
  ```
  ```json
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "VideoObject",
    "name": "Why Word Count Matters for Content and SEO",
    "description": "A short walkthrough of the Troolify Online Word Counter and why word count matters for content and SEO.",
    "thumbnailUrl": "https://img.youtube.com/vi/mx69cUvnd_I/maxresdefault.jpg",
    "uploadDate": "2026-08-10",
    "embedUrl": "https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/mx69cUvnd_I"
  }
  ```
  Add a 1–3 sentence transcript paragraph beneath each `.video-wrap`.
- **Implementation Guidance:** 5 embeds + 5 schema blocks + short transcripts; IDs are already listed above.
- **Fix Type:** schema / content
- **Verification:** Rich Results Test on a tool page should detect `VideoObject`; confirm embed URLs use `youtube-nocookie`.

### 10. IndexNow

- **Files Audited:** repo root
- **Passed Checks:** `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `llms.txt` all present and valid; no staging subdomains or leaked non-production URLs anywhere in the repo.

**Issue 10.1 — IndexNow protocol not implemented.**
- **Severity:** Low
- **Location:** repo root (missing `<key>.txt`)
- **Problem:** No IndexNow key file exists, so Bing, Yandex, Seznam, and Naver can only discover new/updated tool pages via their next scheduled crawl of `sitemap.xml`.
- **Root Cause:** Not set up during the last audit.
- **Ranking Impact:** Faster indexation in non-Google engines, especially when new tool pages launch (you ship ~1/month).
- **Fix:**
  1. Generate a key: `[guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")` → e.g. `3b8a7f1c9d2e4f6a8b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c`.
  2. Publish `https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/<key>.txt` containing only the key string.
  3. Submit on deploy:
  ```powershell
  $body = @{
    host = "f9xr.github.io"
    key = "<key>"
    keyLocation = "https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/<key>.txt"
    urlList = @("https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/","https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/word-counter.html")
  } | ConvertTo-Json
  Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.indexnow.org/IndexNow" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType "application/json"
  ```
- **Implementation Guidance:** Do once; then automate the POST after each deploy in your GitHub Actions workflow.
- **Fix Type:** config
- **Verification:** Expect `200 OK` from `api.indexnow.org`; check the key file returns 200 with only the key text.
